sources: recreation.gov search API for 'Bennett' campgrounds (no North Dakota facility)

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/dpg/recreation/bennett-campground ('No reservations. All sites are on a first-come, first-served basis.'; 'Stay limit of 14 consecutive days.'); recreation.gov search finds no Bennett campground in North Dakota, read 2026-11-12

values.note: Limited services after Labor Day and before Memorial Day; the hand-pump water is off in winter.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/dpg/recreation/bennett-campground ('Open year-round. Limited services after Labor Day and before Memorial Day.'; 'Seasons of Use: Year-round'), read 2026-11-12

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/dpg/recreation/bennett-campground ('13 campsites suitable for tents or RVs'; 'Most campsites accommodate RVs. Three sites are pull-through, and the rest are pull-in/back-in parking.'; 'Parking pads up to 60-feet long.'), read 2026-11-12

values.note: Water is a spring-fed hand-pump well, spring to fall (off in winter); the same page also says 'Potable water is not available at this site.'

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/dpg/recreation/bennett-campground ('Accessible, unisex vault toilet during the summer months.'; 'Potable water is available from a hand-pump well, fed by a spring, from spring to fall (turned off during winter).'), read 2026-11-12

values.note: Pay at the fee tube by the entrance kiosk (envelopes there).

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/dpg/recreation/bennett-campground ('Single Site: $10 per night'; 'Payments should be made via the fee tube, with fee envelopes located at the campground entrance near the kiosk.'), read 2026-11-12

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/dpg/recreation/bennett-campground ('The Senior Pass and the Access Pass holders receive a 50% discount on camping fees per night.'), read 2026-11-12

note: USFS campground on the Little Missouri National Grassland (Dakota Prairie Grasslands, McKenzie Ranger District), ~27 mi S of Watford City: 19 mi S on US-85, 4 mi W on 6th St NW, then 1 mi S on gravel. Open grassland loop in the badlands; three of the sites are pull-throughs. Picnic tables and fire rings with grills. The Maah Daah Hey, Bennett Creek and Cottonwood trailhead is just west (non-motorized). --Claude
summary: USFS page: open year-round (limited services Labor Day-Memorial Day), 13 tent/RV sites, 3 pull-through, pads up to 60 ft, vault toilet, seasonal hand-pump water, $10 at the fee tube, 50% Senior/Access, FCFS only, 14-day limit. Booking/season/sites/facilities/fees/discounts written. Pin ok. Phone flag.
flags: PHONE: none stored -> (701) 842-8500 (McKenzie Ranger District office, named as the contact on the Bennett page).

FACILITIES: the USFS page contradicts itself on water ('Potable water is not available at this site.' directly above 'Potable water is available from a hand-pump well, fed by a spring, from spring to fall'); potable_water true kept with that said in facilities.note.

FIRE: Little Missouri National Grassland fire restriction order 01-18-00-26-02 (June 24 - Dec 31, 2026) bans fires when county fire danger is High+ (campfires in developed-site rings allowed at High) and driving on Prairie Two Track roads; it closes no campground. Not a status.
PIN: stored 47.49111,-103.34806 is the USFS page's coordinate, ~110 m N of the centre of the gravel loop (~47.4903,-103.3488): ok.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront stands; open grassland loop, Bennett Creek is a small badlands drainage south of it.
RIG FIT: 'Most campsites accommodate RVs', pads to 60 ft; gravel access road, no 4WD or rig warning on the page.
